label: batch-51
tail:
**Batch 51 authoring is complete.** I added a local lemma establishing that the finite-bootstrap CDF supremum is measurable, and made the conditional CLT’s subsequence argument explicit. The 19-item batch passes scoped dependency levels, precheck, strict proof contracts, proof layout (36 steps), focused depcheck, content policy, manifest-deps, and rendercheck.

Source locators and dispositions are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-51.notes.md). The full-text sources reviewed include [Efron–Tibshirani](https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.2333/bhmk.12.17_1.pdf), [UW STAT 581 notes](https://sites.stat.washington.edu/jaw/COURSES/580s/581/LECTNOTES/ch8b.pdf), and [Bickel, Götze, and van Zwet](https://www3.stat.sinica.edu.tw/statistica/oldpdf/a7n11.pdf).

**Final readiness records remain blocked.** `step1-decisions.mjs record` fails while reading malformed JSON in the unassigned `research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-26.coverage.json` (line 173, raw `\|` escape). The 18 earlier records predate the final updates and are not claimed as current; the new lemma has no record. The shared batch-level recomputation is blocked by the same file. The live run also retains its separate scaffold YAML blocker. I left both other-pair files and shared owner state untouched; the exact findings are in the notes.

Key handoff files: [conditional CLT](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-conditional-iid-bootstrap-clt-for-empirical-law.md), [measurability lemma](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-finite-bootstrap-cdf-supremum-is-measurable.md), [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-51.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-51.proof-contracts.json).
